summary: This pattern refines Small Context Units: physical size is a review signal, while useful boundaries depend on cohesion, dependency closure and measured task outcomes.

items.text: Read Small Context Units as a local diagnostic rather than a universal 300-line or public-method cap.
Structure as Context supplies the broader principle of making code relationships navigable.
Apply Capability-Conditioned Agent Strategy when evaluating the same change with different model–harness pairs.
